# netactuate_secret_list_value (Resource)

Manages a Secret List Value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_secret_list_value" "example" {
  secret_key     = "example_key"
  secret_list_id = 12345
  secret_value   = "change-me-example-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `secret_key` (String) The key name for this secret
- `secret_list_id` (Number) The ID of the parent secret list
- `secret_value` (String, Sensitive) The secret value

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_secret_list_value.example 12345
```
